character.name: Lee
character.description: Has <@ba.kw>reduced</> Redeployment Time, but <@ba.kw>DP Cost</> is not refunded upon retreating; While deployed, <@ba.kw>3 DP</> are consumed every 3 seconds (automatically retreats without sufficient DP)

character.itemDesc: If you've got nothing else to do, try some of his food, at least.

runtimeMapping.trait: Own deployment-anchored3s timer dispatches native lmlee_tr: consume3, or5 once to arm E2 protection; insufficient DP withdraws without refund. Generic merchant installer is disabled.
runtimeMapping.t1: Block/unblock callbacks and .1s source check sync owned ASPD modifiers. Count uses the full x-4 3x3 range and all living visible enemy motions; exact native hidden-unit/count ordering is not certified.
runtimeMapping.t2: One stored bounce is consumed by next stun/freeze before status application;3s reflection uses enemy eligibility and normal immunity/Resist; ally and sourceless status never stun allies.
runtimeMapping.s1: All source ranks autoactivate at full SP with no target; infinite additive ATK and independent Arts dodge. Native attack playback is uncapped.
runtimeMapping.s2: Passive ASPD; manual requires ground victim. Recast ends existing mark, original facing skill-begin .2 event attaches5s taunt mark. Count HP-damage hit events from allies before mitigation, capped per selected rank; .1s cap check or lifetime/death triggers one immediate Arts radius1 blast on ground/air. Native empty RunePaper projectile is not an extra damage hit. Removal ordering follows kill/block events and source-authored PRTS withdrawal notes.
runtimeMapping.s3: Auto full-SP infinite ATK/DEF/taunt and source x-4 attack range; original begin/idle/loop marker. One damaging fixed-time .15s homing projectile,4 cosmetic trails deferred. At attack event radial force0 pushes other legal ground recipients; excludes current input. Phys/Arts evade tests attacker current position against x-4; sourceless is outside.
runtimeMapping.animations: Actual delivered Front/Back original bindings retained. Back skill-begin is Skill_2_start (lowercase s); ordinary Attack and S3 mode alias Skill_3_Loop use actual hit markers.

verificationLimits: Native FSM and frame-identical animation/controller/selector ordering are not certified.
Modules are disabled. Original rune-paper, shield, knockback and multi-trail particles/audio are retained as source evidence but not Unity-rendered.
S2 RunePaper empty-projectile application uses the source skill-begin attack event; native buff/mitigation missability ordering is not certified.

S3 fixed travel interpolates from operator center; native2.5 startDistance/startDuration/height and cosmetic trails are not reproduced. Shift uses the existing reviewed regular-stage helper, not native Unity collision physics.
T1 full x-4 count includes visible living enemies of either motion; native hidden/untargetable count parity remains unverified.

notes: T2 consumes5 instead3 only without an existing bounce; no allied reflection.
S2 radius1 hits air; target/owner death and recast explode; withdrawal only explodes while blocking marked victim.
S3 uses damage source current location; sourceless is outside.
